model.name: T-item-init-gate: await customElements.whenDefined before first tree render
model.description: R19.88 fix: RoomView.enterRoom must await customElements.whenDefined('rb-object-item') before calling renderMemberList(). Eliminates CE upgrade race where items created before define() runs get no connectedCallback → no cursor, no click, no collapse, no drawer. 1-line await.
